description.en: The text content used for retrieval.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
多知识库合并的方法，默认为RRF，可选项：
- RRF
- Weight
description.en:
The method used to merge results from multiple knowledge bases. Default value: RRF. Valid values:
- RRF
- Weight

description.zh: 各个SourceCollection的合并方法的参数。
description.en: The parameters for the merge method of each SourceCollection.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
重排因子。当该值不为空时，会对向量检索结果再做一次重排。取值范围：1<RerankFactor<=5。
> - 当文档切分稀疏时，重排效率慢。
> - 建议重排个数（TopK*Factor（向上取整））不超过50。
description.en:
The reranking factor. If this parameter is not empty, the vector retrieval results are reranked. Valid values: 1 < RerankFactor <= 5.
> - Reranking is slow when document chunks are sparse.
> - The recommended reranking count (TopK × Factor, rounded up) should not exceed 50.

description.zh: 多路合并后，总路再做一次重排的重排模型参数
description.en: The reranking model parameters for performing an additional reranking on the overall results after multi-channel merging.
The information about the multiple collections to retrieve.

description.zh:
文档库名称。

> 由[CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~)接口创建。您可以调用[ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~)接口查看已经创建的文档库。
description.en:
The document collection name.

> Created by the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation. You can call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to view existing document collections.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace.

> You can create a namespace by calling the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation and view the list by calling the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
The password for the namespace.

> This value is specified by the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

description.zh: 要更新的数据的过滤条件，格式为SQL的WHERE格式。
description.en: The filter conditions for the data to query, in SQL WHERE clause format.

description.zh: 经过多路召回合并后，设置返回top结果数量。
description.en: The number of top results to return after multi-channel recall merging.

title.en: Query content from multiple document collections
